entity.name: Seguros Bolívar Consumer Insurance Plan (Autos & Salud Colombia)
criteria: Is the plan offered by Seguros Bolívar Colombia?
Is the plan category either 'Autos' or 'Salud'?
Is the information from an official segurosbolivar.com or grupobolivar.com.co (Colombia section) domain?
Is the plan for consumers and not a business or corporate offering?
entity.description: Consumer-facing insurance plans offered by Seguros Bolívar in Colombia for Autos and Salud categories, extracted from official sources.

attributes.name: provider_slug
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the insurance provider, always 'seguros_bolivar' for this dataset.

attributes.name: provider_display
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the insurance provider.

attributes.name: category_slug
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the insurance category, either 'autos' or 'salud'.

attributes.name: plan_slug
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the specific insurance plan within Seguros Bolívar for its category.

attributes.name: plan_display
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the insurance plan.

attributes.name: price_min
attributes.description: The minimum price for the plan, if available. Can be null if pricing_model is 'quote'.

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: Indicates how pricing is determined. Either a direct price or 'quote' if a custom quote is required.

attributes.name: benefits
attributes.description: A list of canonical benefits offered by the plan. Must have at least 4 items.

attributes.name: source_primary_url
attributes.description: The official Seguros Bolívar URL where the plan details were found.

attributes.name: last_verified_at
attributes.description: The timestamp when the plan details were last verified by the scraper, representing the scrape time (within 180 days).
